name: Clair de Rune
source:
A point-and-click puzzle game where you attempt to decipher ancient poems to uncover the right sequences of runes, all with the goal of learning a spell to cure your little brother's illness.

[From [url=https://single-cell-studios.itch.io/clair-de-rune]Itch.io[/url]]
